content.title: 2024 Perioperative Cardiovascular Management for Noncardiac Surgery Guideline

sections.title: Anticoagulation for Stroke Prevention
sections.details: Discusses updated approaches for patients with recent episodes of preoperative atrial fibrillation post noncardiac surgery.

sections.title: Cardiovascular Implantable Electronic Devices
sections.details: Reviews the perioperative management of patients with implantable defibrillators and pacemakers. Highlights reports on electromagnetic interference and management strategies.

sections.title: Previous Stroke or Transient Ischemic Attack
sections.details: Examines management of patients with history of stroke or transient ischemic attacks during noncardiac surgery.

sections.title: Obstructive Sleep Apnea
sections.details: Discusses the perioperative screening and management of patients with obstructive sleep apnea undergoing surgery.

genes.context: Effect of continuous electrocardiogram monitoring on detection of undiagnosed atrial fibrillation after hospitalization for cardiac surgery.
